run_compute_nearest_neighbors: run the script to compute k-nearest neighbors for ImageNet features and store them in an HDF5 file
run_with_custom_k: run the nearest neighbor computation with a custom k value using the --k_nn argument
run_with_compression: run the nearest neighbor computation with LZF compression enabled using the --compression flag
run_for_validation_set: run the nearest neighbor computation on the validation split using the --split val argument
run_with_selfsupervised_features: run the nearest neighbor computation using self-supervised features instead of classification features
